spec_reference: PLAN-v1.00.29-PROOF-GRAPH-REDUCTION.md §4 (classes: exact_duplicate / compatible_reusable / distinct_environment / distinct_semantic / observational_only / unknown)

class_semantics.exact_duplicate: identical proof (same selection + environment + strictness) re-executed; no information gain
class_semantics.compatible_reusable: proof that could legitimately satisfy a second gate's requirement (positively proven compatibility); candidate for reuse/caching in later waves
class_semantics.distinct_environment: same semantic selection but different OS / racket version / strictness — NOT compatible by default; requires positive compatibility proof before any reuse
class_semantics.distinct_semantic: different proof content (different selection, artifact-based vs source-based, dry-run vs real)
class_semantics.observational_only: execution exists to observe, not to gate; repetition carries observation value only

pairs.evidence: same --suite fast selection, same ubuntu-latest/current-racket env, same strictness; nightly exists only on schedule
pairs.actionable: W1+ candidate: nightly could consume ci evidence instead of re-executing

pairs.evidence: full-regression runs broader selection under STRICT_TEST_RUNNER=1; superset but different strictness — compatibility not assumed
pairs.actionable: strict-vs-standard equivalence requires positive proof; do not reuse

pairs.evidence: same suite selection, same ubuntu env; release runs without STRICT_TEST_RUNNER, full-regression with it — proven compatible at 293b6a27 because v1.00.28 full-regression run at same-day SHA exercised the identical selection green before the tag
pairs.actionable: positive compatibility proven at this SHA; reuse candidate for W1+ (conditional on sha-equality)

pairs.evidence: both run the platform-cross suite on macos-arm64, standard strictness; incident run 34450089330 shows the full-regression instance cancelled after ci instance already green at nearby SHA
pairs.actionable: W1+ candidate: scheduled platform lane could reuse the most recent green same-tree platform proof

pairs.evidence: same-or-similar selection, older racket versions — compatibility explicitly not assumed
pairs.actionable: keep separate; cross-version cost dominates main CI (1346s of 1361s wall)

pairs.evidence: security runs in STRICT mode with dedicated credential policy lint; overlap with lint-quality subset but different strictness envelope
pairs.actionable: no reuse without strict-mode equivalence proof

pairs.evidence: same workflows suite; full-regression instance runs STRICT_TEST_RUNNER=1
pairs.actionable: workflow-semantic claims keep explicit distinct class; reuse requires positive strict-equivalence proof

pairs.evidence: identical verify-release-bundle invocation over the same artifact bytes at two lifecycle points (278s + 199s in run 34453069107)
pairs.actionable: W1+ candidate: publish-step could re-verify once over final URL or reuse draft verification when artifact digest unchanged

pairs.evidence: source-tree smoke vs built-artifact smoke — different objects under test
both observe prepared-env health; no gate proof either side
pairs.actionable: consolidate telemetry surfaces in W1+ if redundant

pairs.evidence: observation planes; repetition is by design
pairs.actionable: retain; measure their runner-minutes in the duplicate-proof-ratio denominator exclusions

pairs.evidence: telemetry summary of shard plan, not an independent proof
repair path is manual/conditional; not a repeat of the standard pipeline proof

classification_coverage.statement: Every candidate repeat carries an explicit §4 class; zero repetition is counted as duplicate without a class. exact_duplicate=3 (dup-01, dup-04, dup-08), compatible_reusable=1 (dup-03), distinct_environment=4 (dup-02, dup-05, dup-06, dup-07), distinct_semantic=4 (dup-09, dup-10, dup-14, plus dup-03 alternative note), observational_only=3 groupings (dup-11, dup-12, dup-13).

avoidable_duplicate_proof_mass_v0.method: observed runner-minutes of exact_duplicate pairs from retained runs, before any W1+ action

inputs.dup-01_note: no retained nightly run evidence in this wave; excluded from the v0 estimate rather than invented

avoidable_duplicate_proof_mass_v0.estimate_human: ~101 runner-minutes avoidable duplicate proof mass observed in the three retained incident runs alone (platform re-run incl. its 86m39s setup dominates)
avoidable_duplicate_proof_mass_v0.caveat: v0 estimate uses only retained-run observations; fleet-wide mass requires the frozen metric contract computed per run from W1+ onward
